fields.title: PRAZ eGP tender/award record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Record shape depends on 'mode': 'latest'/'former' rows come from the Live Tenders / Former Opportunities bulletin boards (columns read live from the site's own table headers); 'awards' rows come from the Award Notices board; 'detail' rows are a single on-demand tender or award lookup. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). List-mode rows optionally carry a merged 'detail' object with every labeled field from the item's own detail page.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: 'latest' / 'former' / 'awards' for those modes, or the exact tender/award ID or URL requested in 'detail' mode.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-live-tenders-html, S1-former-tenders-html, S1-award-notices-html, S1-tender-detail-html, S1-award-detail-html, or 'none' on failure).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed/degraded records: http_<code>, unexpected_shape, blocked_or_transient, or invalid_input.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_id.title: Row ID
_id.description: (list modes) The tender or award ID extracted from this row's own detail link.

_detailUrl.title: Detail page URL
_detailUrl.description: (list modes) Full URL of this row's detail page on egp.praz.org.zw.

tenderId.title: Tender ID
tenderId.description: (latest/former mode column, or detail mode) PRAZ's internal numeric tender identifier.

tenderReferenceNumber.title: Tender reference number
tenderReferenceNumber.description: (latest/former mode) The procuring entity's own reference code, e.g. 'ZETDC/INTER/28/2025'.

requiredSupplierCategoryName.title: Required supplier category name
requiredSupplierCategoryName.description: (latest/former mode) e.g. 'Electrical Products: Cables and Materials, ...'.

procuringEntity.title: Procuring entity
procuringEntity.description: (latest/former mode) The government body/parastatal running this tender.

publishDate.title: Publish date
publishDate.description: (latest/former mode) Raw date string as shown on the site, e.g. '13-Dec-2025 06:00 AM'.

closingDate.title: Closing date
closingDate.description: (latest/former mode) Bid closing date/time, raw site string.

action.title: Action column
action.description: (former mode) Raw text/label of the row's action column (often blank; 'View Summary Report' when summaryReportUrl is present).

summaryReportUrl.title: Summary report URL
summaryReportUrl.description: (former mode, when present) Link to this tender's award summary report.

awardNoticeNumber.title: Award notice number
awardNoticeNumber.description: (awards mode column, or detail mode) PRAZ's internal numeric award notice identifier.

awardTitle.title: Award title
awardTitle.description: (awards mode) Title of the awarded contract.

awardee.title: Awardee
awardee.description: (awards mode) Name of the winning supplier/company.

detail.title: Full item detail
detail.description: (latest/former/awards mode, when fetchDetails=true) The enriched detail-page object ({fields, rawFields, lineItems}) for this row, present only when its detail page was accessible (see detailError otherwise).

detailError.title: Detail fetch error
detailError.description: (latest/former/awards mode) Set instead of 'detail' when the item's detail page could not be fetched or parsed.

fields.title: Detail fields
fields.description: (detail mode, or nested under 'detail') All detail-page fields as a flat object, keyed by a camelCase version of the site's own field label (e.g. 'procurementMethod', 'bidSecurityAmountDomestic', 'contractAmount'). Field set varies by tender/award type -- this is not a fixed schema.

rawFields.title: Detail fields (raw label/value pairs)
rawFields.description: (detail mode, or nested under 'detail') The same detail-page fields as an ordered array of {label, value}, preserving the exact on-site label text verbatim.

lineItems.title: Line item breakdown
lineItems.description: (detail mode, or nested under 'detail', when present) The tender/award's 'Line Item Details' table (item number, UNSPSC code, lot name/description, quantity, unit of measure), as an array of objects keyed from the table's own headers.
